{"code":"import random

def vary(example, rng):
    # Generate a related scene: two horizontal colored barriers and sparse markers
    h = rng.randint(10, 24)
    w = rng.randint(12, 32)
    g = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    r1 = rng.randint(2, max(2, h//3))
    r2 = rng.randint(r1+3, h-1)
    cA, cB = rng.choice([(3,1),(1,3),(3,1)])
    # full-width barriers
    g[r1] = [cA]*w
    g[r2] = [cB]*w
    # markers in regions: one marker of barrier A below its line, and two B above its line
    # include irrelevant 7 objects above/within regions
    x = rng.randrange(w)
    rr = rng.randrange(r1+1, r2)
    g[rr][x] = cA
    for _ in range(2):
        rr = rng.randrange(0, r2)
        while rr == r1: rr = rng.randrange(0, r2)
        g[rr][rng.randrange(w)] = cB
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
        rr = rng.randrange(h); cc = rng.randrange(w)
        if rr not in (r1,r2) and g[rr][cc] == 0: g[rr][cc] = 7
    return g"}
